hiring.positions_note: Three open posts are classified by the live portal under Educación, Docencia e Investigación/Educación/Docencia: Director(a) de Carrera Educación Parvularia Advance (Puerto Montt), Académicos/as Facultad de Psicología Concepción, and the general “Académicos (as) Universidad San Sebastián” call. The latter explicitly includes Medicina and is the only current medicine-relevant academic call found. No rheumatology or internal-medicine-specific academic vacancy is open today.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: For the medicine-relevant general academic call, the published requirements state: “Grado académico de Doctor (Ph.D. o equivalente) en disciplinas afines a las áreas formativas de la Universidad.” The posted requirements do not state a Chilean nationality requirement, revalidación, or treatment of foreign degrees.

international.notes: USS’s Dirección de Asuntos Internacionales publishes exchange arrangements with more than 115 international institutions and sections for international students and academics. I found no official statement that a Medicina subject is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: USS’s medical faculty is currently titled Facultad de Medicina. Its Escuela de Medicina was created in March 1992. Medicina is offered across USS’s four regional sites: Santiago, Concepción, Valdivia and Puerto Montt.

The faculty page identifies Carlos Pérez as dean and states that students have patient contact through USS health centres from the first year. It also lists clinical-research, simulation and public-health-policy facilities.

Postgraduate Medicine began in 2012 with specialty training linked to Hospital Puerto Montt. Current official programme pages document clinical fields including Hospital Puerto Montt, Hospital Félix Bulnes and Clínica Santa María.

For an academic approach, USS has a live general call for PhD holders that expressly includes Medicina and covers undergraduate/postgraduate teaching, applied research and clinical-health linkage. Its published requirements do not mention Chilean nationality or revalidation.

No named USS rheumatology unit or rheumatology specialty programme was located on the official faculty and postgraduate pages. A rheumatologist, Loreto Massardo, is listed as a Faculty of Medicine member of the USS scientific ethics committee.
